subject: reasoning
question: Gopi, Piyush, Mohan, Rahul, Shreya and Monika are sitting in a row. Shreya and Monika are in the centre. Gopi and Piyush are at the ends. Mohan is sitting to the left of Gopi. Who is to the right of Piyush?
solution:
The logic followed is:

**Logic: **There are six persons sitting in a row. We have to go through all the conditions and have to make a sitting arrangement.

Gopi and Piyush are sitting at the ends. Mohan is sitting left Gopi. Therefore, Gopi must be sitting on the right end. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c6fd51b492bcf276ed8325e2d76c13a51e730ce20be7dce70c15c0b7cc1b4fa7.png] 

Now, Shreya and Monika are sitting at the centre. Only one place will be remain in which Rahul must be sitting. 

So, there can be two cases.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7032844d35c52ae520ae4205706c419944d01af5f3aa06f110d9ae00af0309d8.png] 

As it can be seen that in both cases Rahul is sitting right of Piyush.

Therefore, the correct answer is **"Rahul".**
